title: HTTP cache and append-only journal semantics
summary: CivicPort cache/journal state is evidence, not mutable truth. Body-bearing documents, revalidation observations, stale fallbacks and integrity checks remain distinct and recoverable.
invariants: HTTP 304 creates a new observation tied to a prior body-bearing document; it does not mutate the prior document.
MISS/FRESH/REVALIDATED/STALE describe cache behavior, not semantic truth.
Journal records are append-only and integrity-checked; torn tails and orphan records fail closed or are skipped according to the sealed recovery contract.
Parser-native JSON lexical numeric strings survive journal round-trips unchanged.
Evidence-bearing User-Agent is cache-keyed; arbitrary unkeyed caller headers remain refused.
procedure: Construct request/cache identity from all evidence-bearing representation selectors.
Append immutable document/observation evidence before exposing a cache result.
On restart, verify index/record digests before reconstructing state.
Preserve stale/revalidation cause separately from body identity.

provenance.claim: Credential-aware journal generation and backward reader compatibility.
Append-only cache journal and conditional revalidation origin.
Evidence-bearing User-Agent is retained and cache-keyed while other caller headers remain rejected.
